original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳北部因光缆中断出现大规模语音和数据服务中断
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳国家通信管理局（NCA）宣布，因光缆中断，加纳北部五个地区及奥蒂地区部分地区出现严重的语音和数据服务中断。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: five northern regions of Ghana and parts of the Oti Region

key_facts.fact: 加纳国家通信管理局宣布北部五个地区及奥蒂地区部分地区语音和数据服务严重中断
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Communications Authority (NCA) has announced a significant disruption to voice and data services across the five northern regions of Ghana and parts of the Oti Region.
NCA announces major voice and data disruption across Northern Ghana due to fibre cuts

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（MyJoyOnline）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
中断的具体范围与恢复时间尚未明确
